title: FAQ restore: answers release #148 removed by accident
why: Release #148 (control-board-3f) carried a copy of app/ui/faq.md built on an older sync, so it took out live text: release #147's two entries ("Can I pass a message on from my Pulse?", "Can I report, block or mute someone from my Pulse?") and its newer wording on six answers (Releases, staging's Held list, My inbox, one row per thing, a group's Mute, moderators' requests, a row opened in place), and Release 1's entry (#146) "Does loading Traversence's fonts tell another company I visited?". This puts back exactly that text, word for word: the live copy with #148's FAQ change reversed. #149's entries stay. No other change.
